items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I had talked with Mr. Wells that owns the Wells Restaurant.

ctx.x: Where did you first meet him - the Hickory House? Where did you first meet Father O'Brien?

It's a strange thing. Father Peter O'Brien was going to school down where Father Woods was, a young boy. See, I met him when he was 19 or 20. He was not really a friend of Father Woods' but he knew Father Woods. I happened to be playing in the Hickory House and this little young boy, happy and everything, walked in and sat at the bar. He'd come to see me often. He left and I discovered that he did know Father Woods. We became very close friends, Father Peter O'Brien and I. You know, a Jesuit priest never stops…
